title: Validation report of lernapps check, version 1
description: What `lernapps check` checked and found, as YAML: on standard output when a check fails, and always in the file of `--report <file>`. The same input gives the same report. A breaking change gets a new version of this schema.

checked.description: What was checked: the commit of a repo (or its directory outside git), a bundle directory, or a URL and the time it was checked.

parts.description: In a repo: the parts that ran, pre-commit (format, lint, types) and pre-push (unit tests, build, checks of the built app, end-to-end tests).

rules.description: The ids of the rules checked: every check that found something to check, and checks-pass for the toolchain steps.

findings.description: Every finding, sorted by rule id and place. Exit code 1 when one has severity error.

where.description: File and line, page and element, or the command

link.description: The rule's entry on the rule page

suppressions.description: Warnings suppressed in place, each with its reason.

fitness.description: The fitness values measured on the built app, without a click, in the words of the catalog entry.

storage.description: none: nothing stored; device: only in the browser

thirdParty.description: none: no request to another host before a click; before-click: requests that keep the app from being listed
